verses.en: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
verses.pt: Tendo Jesus entrado, num sábado, em casa de um dos chefes dos fariseus para comer pão, eles o estavam observando.
verses.en_web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that when he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees on the Sabbath, to have a meal, they were watching him.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
verses.pt: Achava-se ali diante dele certo homem hidrópico.
verses.en_web: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
verses.en_bbe: And a certain man was there who had a disease.

verses.en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
verses.pt: E Jesus, tomando a palavra, falou aos doutores da lei e aos fariseus, e perguntou: É lícito curar no sábado, ou não?
verses.en_web: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, answering, said to the scribes and Pharisees, Is it right to make people well on the Sabbath or not?

verses.en: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
verses.pt: Eles, porém, ficaram calados. E Jesus, pegando no homem, o curou, e o despediu.
verses.en_web: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
verses.en_bbe: But they said nothing. And he made him well and sent him away.

verses.en: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
verses.pt: Então lhes perguntou: Qual de vós, se lhe cair num poço um filho, ou um boi, não o tirará logo, mesmo em dia de sábado?
verses.en_web: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Which of you, whose ox or ass has got into a water-hole, will not straight away get him out on the Sabbath?

verses.en: And they could not answer him again to these things.
verses.pt: A isto nada puderam responder.
verses.en_web: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
verses.en_bbe: And they had no answer to that question.

verses.en: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
verses.pt: Ao notar como os convidados escolhiam os primeiros lugares, propôs-lhes esta parábola:
verses.en_web: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave teaching in the form of a story to the guests who came to the feast, when he saw how they took the best seats; saying to them,

verses.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
verses.pt: Quando por alguém fores convidado às bodas, não te reclines no primeiro lugar; não aconteça que esteja convidado outro mais digno do que tu;
verses.en_web: “When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
verses.en_bbe: When you get a request to come to a feast, do not take the best seat, for a more important man than you may be coming,

verses.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
verses.pt: e vindo o que te convidou a ti e a ele, te diga: Dá o lugar a este; e então, com vergonha, tenhas de tomar o último lugar.
verses.en_web: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
verses.en_bbe: And then the giver of the feast will come to you and say, Give your place to this man; and you, with shame, will have to take the lowest seat.

verses.en: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
verses.pt: Mas, quando fores convidado, vai e reclina-te no último lugar, para que, quando vier o que te convidou, te diga: Amigo, sobe mais para cima. Então terás honra diante de todos os que estiverem contigo à mesa.
verses.en_web: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
verses.en_bbe: But when you come, go and take the lowest seat, so that when the giver of the feast comes, he may say to you, Friend, come up higher; and then you will have honour in the eyes of all the others who are there.

verses.en: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.pt: Porque todo o que a si mesmo se exaltar será humilhado, e aquele que a si mesmo se humilhar será exaltado.
verses.en_web: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
verses.en_bbe: For every man who gives himself a high place will be put down, but he who takes a low place will be lifted up.

verses.en: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
verses.pt: Disse também ao que o havia convidado: Quando deres um jantar, ou uma ceia, não convides teus amigos, nem teus irmãos, nem teus parentes, nem os vizinhos ricos, para que não suceda que também eles te tornem a convidar, e te seja isso retribuído.
verses.en_web: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the master of the house, When you give a feast, do not send for your friends and your brothers and your family or your neighbours who have wealth, for they may give a feast for you, and so you will get a reward.

verses.en: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.pt: Mas quando deres um banquete, convida os pobres, os aleijados, os mancos e os cegos;
verses.en_web: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
verses.en_bbe: But when you give a feast, send for the poor and the blind and those who are broken in body:

verses.en: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
verses.pt: e serás bem-aventurado; porque eles não têm com que te retribuir; pois retribuído te será na ressurreição dos justos.
verses.en_web: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
verses.en_bbe: And you will have a blessing, because they will not be able to give you any payment, and you will get your reward when the upright come back from the dead.

verses.en: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: Ao ouvir isso um dos que estavam com ele à mesa, disse-lhe: Bem-aventurado aquele que comer pão no reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
verses.en_bbe: And, hearing these words, one of those who were at table with him said to him, Happy is the man who will be a guest in the kingdom of God.

verses.en: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, lhe disse: Certo homem dava uma grande ceia, e convidou a muitos.
verses.en_web: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, A certain man gave a great feast, and sent word of it to a number of people.

verses.en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
verses.pt: E à hora da ceia mandou o seu servo dizer aos convidados: vinde, porque tudo já está preparado.
verses.en_web: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
verses.en_bbe: And when the time had come, he sent his servants to say to them, Come, for all things are now ready.

verses.en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.pt: Mas todos à uma começaram a escusar-se. Disse-lhe o primeiro: Comprei um campo, e preciso ir vê-lo; rogo-te que me dês por escusado.
verses.en_web: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
verses.en_bbe: And they all gave reasons why they were not able to come. The first said to him, I have got a new field, and it is necessary for me to go and see it: I am full of regret that I am unable to come.

verses.en: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.pt: Outro disse: Comprei cinco juntas de bois, e vou experimentá-los; rogo-te que me dês por escusado.
verses.en_web: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
verses.en_bbe: And another said, I have got some cattle, and I am going to make a test of them: I am full of regret that I am unable to come.

verses.en: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.pt: Ainda outro disse: Casei-me e portanto não posso ir.
verses.en_web: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
verses.en_bbe: And another said, I have been married, and so I am not able to come.

verses.en: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
verses.pt: Voltou o servo e contou tudo isto a seu senhor: Então o dono da casa, indignado, disse a seu servo: Sai depressa para as ruas e becos da cidade e traze aqui os pobres, os aleijados, os cegos e os coxos.
verses.en_web: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
verses.en_bbe: And the servant came back and gave his master an account of these things. Then the master of the house was angry and said to the servant, Go out quickly into the streets of the town and get the poor, the blind, and those who are broken in body.

verses.en: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
verses.pt: Depois disse o servo: Senhor, feito está como o ordenaste, e ainda há lugar.
verses.en_web: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
verses.en_bbe: And the servant said, Lord, your orders have been done, and still there is room.

verses.en: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.pt: Respondeu o senhor ao servo: Sai pelos caminhos e valados, e obriga-os a entrar, para que a minha casa se encha.
verses.en_web: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.en_bbe: And the lord said to the servant, Go out into the roads and the fields, and make them come in, so that my house may be full.

verses.en: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
verses.pt: Pois eu vos digo que nenhum daqueles homens que foram convidados provará a minha ceia.
verses.en_web: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.’”
verses.en_bbe: For I say to you that not one of those who were requested to come will have a taste of my feast.

verses.en: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
verses.pt: Ora, iam com ele grandes multidões; e, voltando-se, disse-lhes:
verses.en_web: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
verses.en_bbe: Now a great number of people went with him.

verses.en: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.pt: Se alguém vier a mim, e não aborrecer a pai e mãe, a mulher e filhos, a irmãos e irmãs, e ainda também à própria vida, não pode ser meu discípulo.
verses.en_web: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
verses.en_bbe: And turning round, he said to them, If any man comes to me, and has not hate for his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters, and even for his life, he may not be my disciple.

verses.en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
verses.pt: Quem não leva a sua cruz e não me segue, não pode ser meu discípulo.
verses.en_web: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever does not take up his cross and come after me may not be my disciple.

verses.en: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
verses.pt: Pois qual de vós, querendo edificar uma torre, não se senta primeiro a calcular as despesas, para ver se tem com que a acabar?
verses.en_web: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
verses.en_bbe: For which of you, desiring to put up a tower, does not first give much thought to the price, if he will have enough to make it complete?

verses.en: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
verses.pt: Para não acontecer que, depois de haver posto os alicerces, e não a podendo acabar, todos os que a virem comecem a zombar dele,
verses.en_web: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
verses.en_bbe: For fear that if he makes a start and is not able to go on with it to the end, all who see it will be laughing at him,

verses.en: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
verses.pt: dizendo: Este homem começou a edificar e não pode acabar.
verses.en_web: saying, ‘This man began to build, and wasn’t able to finish.’
verses.en_bbe: And saying, This man made a start at building and is not able to make it complete.

verses.en: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
verses.pt: Ou qual é o rei que, indo entrar em guerra contra outro rei, não se senta primeiro a consultar se com dez mil pode sair ao encontro do que vem contra ele com vinte mil?
verses.en_web: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
verses.en_bbe: Or what king, going to war with another king, will not first take thought if he will be strong enough, with ten thousand men, to keep off him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

verses.en: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
verses.pt: No caso contrário, enquanto o outro ainda está longe, manda embaixadores, e pede condições de paz.
verses.en_web: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.
verses.en_bbe: Or while the other is still a great distance away, he sends representatives requesting conditions of peace.

verses.en: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, todo aquele dentre vós que não renuncia a tudo quanto possui, não pode ser meu discípulo.
verses.en_web: So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
verses.en_bbe: And so whoever is not ready to give up all he has may not be my disciple.

verses.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
verses.pt: Bom é o sal; mas se o sal se tornar insípido, com que se há de restaurar-lhe o sabor?
verses.en_web: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
verses.en_bbe: For salt is good, but if the taste goes from it, of what use is it?

verses.en: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.pt: Não presta nem para terra, nem para adubo; lançam-no fora. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
verses.en_web: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.en_bbe: It is no good for the land or for the place of waste; no one has a use for it. He who has ears, let him give ear.
